description: Re-sign the CA certificate bundle in place with a new validity period, keeping keys, subjects, serials, and extensions. Run on the CA host while OpenVox Server is stopped. Backs up every file it replaces.

ttl.description: New lifetime for the CA certificate, in the CA gem's format: a number with an optional y, d, h, m, or s suffix.

crls.description: Which CRLs to re-sign: only expired ones, all of them, or none.

dry_run.description: Compute and report the change without writing any file.

force.description: Proceed even if puppetserver appears to be running.

section.description: The puppet.conf section to resolve settings from.
